title: prunus pumila var. susquehanae
intro: Prunus pumila var. susquehanae, commonly known as American dwarf cherry, is a shrub species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of American dwarf cherry include its ability to reduce fever, treat gastrointestinal issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
